## Wave 2 Summary

Wave 2 closes the single completeness/provenance gap that HELD each of four S107 blind-PASS-AND Stage-2 verifies. At S107, the structural spines of §VII.AC.1 (K2), §VII.AC.4 (K11), §VII.X.W4-1 (K7), and §VII.X.2-NECESSITY (K9) all PASS-AND'd blind on BOTH axes (two-agent, no-prior-workshop-context cross-reviewers) — the composites landed INFO not because any structural clause FAILed, but because one registry-completeness leg per entry was HELD (an audit-substituted Mellin-pole tag, a prose-only laboratory-IN observable, or a stale anchor-availability diagnostic). This wave produces the substrate-physics determination that lifts each HELD leg, then completes the STAGE-1-CANDIDATE → STAGE-3-PERMANENT promotion bookkeeping where the promotion is owed.

This is a **parallel-compute cohort** (Q3 per `.claude/rules/Investigating-Workshops.md`): four INDEPENDENT gates, each on its own pre-registered PASS criterion, **NO wave-level AND**. The per-gate agent attribution is a derivation-author tag (which agent owns the math for that registry entry), not a workshop-participant tag — no adversarial round protocol, because the four legs are structurally orthogonal (a Mellin-residue poleconv resolution, two Element-2 OE-form retrofits on different pillars, and a SHA-harvest verification do not rebut one another).

  biconditional.
FAIL_meaning: >

  STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; emit the present/absent partition, route the missing anchor(s) to a successor-emission
  gate. (NOTE: the S88 promote-gate reported 6/6=TRUE, so a FAIL would indicate a since-S88 verdict-file
  drift or a SHA-set mismatch between the S88-script enumeration and the registered table — that mismatch is
  the informative finding.) FAIL is NOT a structural retraction of the necessity meta-theorem (its clauses
  PASS-AND'd blind at S107); it is a registry-completeness hold.
INFO_meaning: >

  enumeration name DIFFERENT 6-anchor sets (the S88 script counts the S87 aggregation gate fa225aac… as
  "anchor 6"; the registered table names S82 MP-Exclusion 98267d63… as anchor-5). The harvest succeeds under
  either reading (all named SHAs are on disk); the INFO records the enumeration reconciliation. Promotion
  fires; the WP documents the canonical 6-anchor set adopted.

## Wave 2 → Wave 3 Decision Point

Wave 2 is the terminal §VII-completion cohort; there is no S108 Wave 3 that consumes Wave 2 outputs (per the context-file source manifest, S108 = Wave 1 §VII.CB remediation + Wave 2 §VII-completion cohort; no further waves are seeded). Per-gate post-conditions:

- **§W2-1 PASS** → §VII.AC.1 (K2) + §VII.AC.4 (K11) STAGE-3-PERMANENT. Knowledge-index `/weave --update` re-stamps atlas-07 (the stale "PERMANENT" surface noted in the §VII.AC.4 S107 blockquote is re-reconciled to the live STAGE-3 state). Decision: on FAIL, both stay STAGE-1-CANDIDATE and the audit-substituted pole tag persists (route a follow-up substrate-first re-extraction to S109).
- **§W2-2 PASS** → §VII.X.W4-1 (K7) STAGE-3-PERMANENT (3rd blind-verified cross-pillar bridge). On FAIL, stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the q=II OE-form determination routes to S109.
- **§W2-3 PASS** → whole-registry Element-2 defective count = 0; §VII.AG.1 STAGE-3 status UNCHANGED. On INFO (additional defect surfaced), route the newly-counted item; §VII.AG.1's own retrofit is independent.
- **§W2-4 PASS** → §VII.X.2-NECESSITY (K9) STAGE-3-PERMANENT across 4 surfaces. On FAIL (<6/6 on disk), the harvest becomes the gate; the missing anchor's successor-emission routes to S109.

These four post-conditions combine by simple union of independent registry-state landings (NO wave-level AND). Each gate's STAGE-3 promotion (where owed) is the per-entry registry-PASS event per `joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 3"`; the orchestrator's session-end synthesis updates each tag from STAGE-1-CANDIDATE to STAGE-3-PERMANENT on that gate's PASS.

## Wave 2 Pre-Dispatch Audit Order (per `epistemic-discipline.md §"Pre-Registration Completeness"`)

The plan-freeze validators run in the canonical order before any gate dispatches:
`PRU (cardinality) → SOURCE-RECON (pin-vs-canonical drift) → SUBSTRATE-FIRST-PROVENANCE (source-existence) → DEFERRED-PENDING REGISTRY-ANATOMY (S2 advisory) → PRDR (machinery enumeration) → gate execution → v3-recovery audit.`

- **PRU / PRDR**: all 4 gates fill the 8 R3 items + `schema_version: R3`; no machinery parameter is left unpinned (the executor-choice convention candidates on W2-1 — poleconv A-double, d=8 — and W2-4 — 6-anchor-set reading — are PINNED with the Sage-exact resolution / the canonical S88-script enumeration, NOT left for runtime discovery; the executor either confirms or honestly documents a Class-1 structural correction).
- **SOURCE-RECON**: no plan pin is a numerical constant drifting from a canonical (the only numerical pins — `a_2_FW_zeta=2776.165389` cited in framing, the 6/6 anchor count, the L_max=10 — match their canonical/registered sources). W2-1's `a_2^{Mellin}` regulator-pin is the substrate-first channel determination, not a value pin.
- **SUBSTRATE-FIRST-PROVENANCE**: every numerical determination sources from substrate-first computation (W2-1 Mellin residue on the D_K cache; W2-4 SHA-grep on on-disk physics verdicts) or the registered entry text (W2-2/W2-3 OE-form transcription of the eq_6636/eq_6637 NCG identity). No external-paper provenance is treated as canonical; no SCHEMATIC helper is consumed.
- **Cross-pillar bridge anatomy (Element-2 OE-form discipline, MANDATORY at plan-freeze)**: W2-2 and W2-3 are the gates that EFFECT the Element-2 OE-form compliance (named projector + explicit Tr + integration domain) the discipline requires; the gate PASS criterion IS the `_cross_pillar_bridge_audit.py` positive regex. W2-1's parse-tree expansion satisfies `registry-landing.md §"Parse-Tree Expansion Pre-Registration"`. None of the four entries is registry-INCOMPLETE on the 5-anatomy/3-level ladder (all five elements + three levels are present in each registered block; these gates complete the ONE held leg per entry).
- **Bridge-landing single-shot AFTER-pattern (MANDATORY, `registry-landing.md`)**: W2-1, W2-2, W2-3, and W2-4 each write a registry/atlas edit AND emit a verdict in the same run, so each producing script MUST follow `build_promotion_text → write_atomic_with_fsync → re_read + verify_section_matches → emit exactly ONE verdict line`. The BEFORE pattern (conditional rewrite on intermediate FAIL) is FORBIDDEN. If `verify_section_matches` FAILs, the script emits FAIL ONCE and the gate honestly closes per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md` (no in-script corrective rewrite; remediation escalates to S109). The `output_artifacts.script.must_contain` for all four gates pins `build_promotion_text` + `write_atomic_with_fsync` + `verify_section_matches` to enforce this at the artifact-verification layer.
